defect: The fix changes const_val.value to const_val->value because the later commit 0f52ecf turned const_val into a pointer; in this change const_val was a reference and the line compiled.
reason: The compile error was introduced by the intermediate commit 0f52ecf, not by this change.

defect: The new zone-map OR shortcut returns FILTER_ALWAYS_FALSE when pushdown is judged not worthwhile, which the statistics propagator treats as 'no row matches' and replaces the scan with an empty result.
reason: The fix returns FILTER_ALWAYS_TRUE instead (and retunes the threshold) in exactly the lines this change added, and the inverted result is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix only adds NOLINT comments for clang-tidy naming checks on the STL-style API.
reason: Tidy annotation with no behavioural change.

defect: The fix reorders last_progress and initialized in the constructor initializer list to match their declaration order (-Wreorder).
reason: That ordering mismatch existed before this change, which only appended scale_factor, and it has no runtime effect.

defect: The fix adds UnsafeNumericCast and a NOLINT cast for size_t-to-uint32_t narrowing that clang-tidy flags.
reason: String sizes here are bounded by the block size and -Wall does not flag these conversions, so this is lint cleanup, not a defect repair.

defect: The fix replaces an int-typed string_block_limit = 16384, which causes a signed/unsigned comparison warning, with a constexpr idx_t.
reason: This change used the idx_t from GetStringBlockLimit; the int literal behind the warning was introduced later by 85d6eff.

defect: The rewritten RefineCandidates keeps a candidate when RefineCandidateNextChunk succeeds or the candidate has an error (the !! double negation), keeps errored candidates that finished the file, and breaks after the first kept candidate, which drops the remaining candidates.
reason: The fix corrects exactly these conditions and break statements, all of which this change added.

defect: The fix passes options with std::move to satisfy a clang-tidy performance check.
reason: Tidy cleanup; the copy was not a defect.

defect: The fix replaces the constructor ChunkScanState(idx_t position), whose parameter is unused, with an explicit default constructor for clang-tidy.
reason: The code compiled and behaved correctly, so this is tidy cleanup.

defect: BloomFilterState allocates hashes_v, keys_flat_v and bf_sel with a fixed STANDARD_VECTOR_SIZE capacity, replacing per-call buffers sized to approved_tuple_count, so larger inputs overflow them and segfault.
reason: The fix adds current_capacity and grows the state buffers; seeing the overflow needs bloom_filter.hpp, where this commit replaced the per-call-sized buffers.

defect: The row-limit reorderer added with these declarations (AddRowGroupWithLimit tracking a single row_group_boundary) miscounts qualifying tuples: its MIN-side comparison is missing and it counts overlapping row groups without checking distinctness, so row groups the limit needs can be cut off.
reason: The fix rewrites that logic in scan_state.cpp and changes the declarations this change added; the defect is in the .cpp of the same commit.

defect: use_limit enables row-group pruning by row count even when an aggregate sits between the Top-N and the scan or an order is NULLS FIRST, so row groups that hold result rows can be skipped.
reason: The fix disables use_limit in those cases inside the CanReorderRowGroups logic that this change added.

defect: The fix renames the types parameter so the CanCacheType loop reads the member instead of the moved-from parameter, and checks enable_cache in Execute.
reason: This commit only reformats; the shadowing constructor and the missing enable_cache check existed before it.

defect: In this file the fix only adds override and final specifiers to CachingOperatorState members.
reason: Style change; the enable_cache defect it accompanies is in .cpp code written later.

defect: JoinHashTable::Merge checks partition_block_collections.empty() before taking partition_lock and merges partitions in the else branch without the lock, so concurrent merges race and can insert partitions twice or merge into a vector that is still being filled.
reason: The fix takes the lock for the whole partition merge, replacing the check-then-lock pattern this change added.

defect: The new binder binds each listed column through bind_context.BindColumn, which deduplicates column ids and asserts on generated columns, so ANALYZE t(x, x) or a table with generated columns leaves column_id_map out of step with the per-column stats and fails.
reason: The fix rejects duplicate names, skips generated columns and maps to storage oids; seeing the mismatch needs TableBinding::Bind and PhysicalVacuum.

defect: The fix declares time_seed as auto instead of uint64_t to silence a signed-to-unsigned conversion warning.
reason: The seed value is unaffected, so this is warning cleanup, not a defect.

defect: The fix changes the free-list loop variable from idx_t to block_id_t to silence a GCC -Wsign-compare warning against max_block.
reason: max_block is never negative, so the comparison behaves correctly; only an opt-in warnings-as-errors build fails, which I treat as warning cleanup.

defect: The fix makes the reorder_idx parameter of GatherAliases a const reference.
reason: Style change; the code compiled and behaved the same.

defect: PythonFilesystem now stores protocols and name as const references to constructor arguments, which dangle once the caller's local protocols vector goes out of scope.
reason: The fix restores ownership of protocols, undoing the reference members this change introduced.

defect: In this file the fix only passes protocols with std::move.
reason: At this commit PythonFilesystem stored protocols by value, so passing the local vector was correct; the dangling reference came later with d3a7edb.

defect: The fix moves the templated GetPointer/GetPointerDollar helpers and their specializations out of the class body into namespace-scope header code.
reason: Those templates and in-class explicit specializations were added later by d43cc13; the non-template code of this change is not what the fix repairs.

defect: GetPointerDollar calls IsObj<yyjson_t>, ObjGetN<yyjson_t> and the other helpers with explicit template arguments, which select the primary templates that throw 'Unknown yyjson type' instead of the non-template overloads, so every '$' path query fails; the header part also adds in-class explicit specializations that GCC rejects.
reason: The fix replaces these with proper out-of-class specializations in the header; the mix-up between template and overloads is visible in the diff.

defect: TransformAddColumn reads IF NOT EXISTS from child 1, which is the optional COLUMN keyword in AddColumn <- 'ADD' 'COLUMN'? IfNotExists? ColumnDefinition, so ADD COLUMN behaves as IF NOT EXISTS and the real flag is ignored.
reason: The fix changes the index to 2; seeing the mistake needs the grammar file.

defect: The fix moves footer_size in the constructor initializer list to match the declaration order.
reason: footer_size was added by a later commit; at this change the initializer order matched the declarations.

defect: The fix renames the debug pragma to enable_zstd_dictionary_limit and adds a disable_zstd_dictionary_limit counterpart.
reason: API or feature change to a testing pragma, not a defect repair.

defect: In this file the fix moves the VARCHAR heap-size computation into StringHeapSize (adding a zero contribution for NULLs) and adds const qualifiers; the null-BLOB bug itself is fixed in tuple_data_allocator.cpp.
reason: The IsInlined check this change added gives the same heap sizes as the fixed code.

defect: The fix tests the first file scan instead of the last for the empty-file shortcut in GetProgress and removes null checks that this change added.
reason: The back()->file_size test predates this change and the added null checks were harmless, so the fix does not repair a defect introduced here.

defect: While re-adding a header, this change reverted WriteSecret from the temp-file-plus-MoveFile write (the fix for issue 13077) back to deleting and rewriting the secret file in place, so a secret file can be left partial or missing.
reason: The fix restores the atomic temp-file write that this diff visibly removed.

defect: Sending all-NULL arguments to BindListConcat makes the string concat function return NULL for concat(NULL) instead of '' (concat treats NULL as an empty string).
reason: The fix restores a VARCHAR binding for the non-operator, non-list case in the all_null branch this change added.

defect: The header size is computed as sizeof(2 * sizeof(uint32_t)), which is sizeof(size_t) rather than 8, so on 32-bit platforms the offset advances only 4 bytes after two uint32 sizes are stored.
reason: The fix replaces it with 2 * sizeof(uint32_t) in both places this change added.

defect: The fix corrects LowerBound: it starts with equal=true, pops the current key when backing out, pushes the key byte, and falls back to Next instead of GetMin.
reason: This change moved Bound from art.cpp with the same logic, so the lower-bound bug existed before it.

defect: The fix adds a force_stream_and_no_parallel path for the LIMIT 1 nodes that the subquery planner and the statistics propagator create in the #4152 fix.
reason: The wrong result in #4152 came from semi/anti join pruning in propagate_join.cpp; the plan_limit edit adds an option and does not repair this change's lines.

defect: The fix drops .second from val.struct_value[i] because Value::struct_value changed from child_list_t<Value> to vector<Value> in a concurrent commit.
reason: At this change struct_value was a list of pairs, so the code was correct.

defect: Moving the BufferHandles out of temp_scan_state's handle map leaves moved-from handles there, so a later Scan of the same block reuses an empty handle and crashes (issue 6204, for example range(2049)).
reason: The fix removes the handle-moving code and scans with DISALLOW_ZERO_COPY; seeing the reuse needs the allocator's handle lookup.

defect: The fix replaces direct Vector::data accesses with GetData() to follow an API change.
reason: API adaptation; the .data uses compiled and worked at this change.

defect: The header still declares NumpyToLogicalType(const NumpyNullableType &) while type.cpp defines it for NumpyType and the callers now pass a NumpyType, so the Python package does not compile.
reason: The fix updates the declaration; seeing the mismatch needs type.cpp and the callers.

defect: The fix adds per-unit datetime conversion (s, ms, us, ns) and adapts to the NumpyType struct.
reason: This change was a pure rename; the conversion code the fix replaces was written later.

defect: The fix adapts the comparisons to the NumpyType struct (numpy_type.type).
reason: This change was a rename; the fix follows a later API change.

defect: Node16::erase calls child[15].release(), which gives up ownership without deleting the child node, so the node leaks.
reason: The fix changes release() to reset() on the line this change added.
